claim: The ROM sign-off ledger identifies the game and build: project MILLIPEDE, dated Sept. 29 1982, version 1.

source.verbatim: Documentation Disk(s):  48A		Project Name:  MILLIPEDE			Date:  Sept. 29, 1982		Version:  1

claim: The first of four program EPROMs, 136013-101, sits at PCB location H1 and CPU address 7000 (a 2532 4Kx8).
The last program EPROM, 136013-104, at M/N1 maps to address 4000 — the set 101..104 tiles the program space down from 7000.
The first picture EPROM, 136013-106, at N/P5 (a 2716 2Kx8) — the graphics ROMs, a separate set from the program EPROMs.
The second picture EPROM, 136013-107, at R5 — with -106 these two hold the 8x8 stamps ml2 decodes from the MAME set.
The verification image is MILLI.LDA (control file 013X1.DAT) — the linked CPU program load image, not the picture pixels.

source.verbatim: Verification control filename:  013X1.DAT		Verification file:  MILLI.LDA

claim: The linker command builds the program image from MILLI, MLSUB, MLATR, CONWAY and MLCOIN.
The link map continues with MLIRQ and MLTST — seven CPU modules linked into MILLI.LDA.
